# Quaternius RPG Characters

Source: Quaternius, **RPG Characters - Nov 2020** (Warrior, Wizard, Ranger).

Original download: `/home/tom/code/game-assets/quaternius/All in One - Quaternius[Patreon].zip`

Archive members: `Characters and Animals/RPG Characters - Nov 2020/glTF/Warrior.gltf`,
`Characters and Animals/RPG Characters - Nov 2020/glTF/Wizard.gltf`, and
`Characters and Animals/RPG Characters - Nov 2020/glTF/Ranger.gltf`.

The included `LICENSE.txt` is the pack's CC0 license. Greywrought uses each
model's built-in sword, staff or bow with its authored attachment and animation.
Only Idle, Run, Roll, RecieveHit, Death and the class's Sword_Attack, Staff_Attack
or Bow_Shoot clip are retained. Roll supplies the aerial somersault.
Unused animation accessors and buffer views were removed; identical remaining
views share bytes. Retained geometry, skin, textures and clip data are unchanged.
The results are packed as binary GLB under `greywrought:assets/external/quaternius/class-characters/`.
